usage: Pu-erh is used as a noun to refer to a specific type of fermented tea.
You can say 'I am drinking pu-erh tea' to indicate the type of tea you are having.
When using pu-erh in a sentence, it often appears with tea-related words like 'tea' or 'cup'.
Pu-erh can also be used in requests, for example, ordering it at a restaurant or tea house.
It is common to use pu-erh with adjectives describing its flavor or age.
